detail.goal: Sign on as operator "teller1" with [REDACTED] "[REDACTED]" at branch "MAIN-001", then from the Main Menu choose Member Inquiry / Selection, search for member number "100234" (leave "Search by" set to Member Number), select that member from the results, and once you reach the Member Record page: extract the member's Name (store as "memberName"); then, in the SHARES / BALANCES table, extract the Balance shown in the very first (topmost) row -- store as "primaryShareBalance" -- and the Status shown in that same first row -- store as "primaryShareStatus". The first row is always that member's Regular Shares account. Do not extract any other row.
